newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong equity funds outperform in August.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong equity funds outperform in August.

text.p: Hong Kong equity funds topped the performance charts from the Hong Kong Investment Funds Association in August, the association said on Tuesday.

Rising Hong Kong stocks were credited with helping Hong Kong equity funds report an annualized return of 26.65 percent in the month, aided by the relaxation of China's monetary policy and improved sentiment in Hong Kong's property market.
"In addition, so far most of the major companies have reported very positive results in this reporting season," said HKIFA chairman Andrew Lo.
CIBC-CEF Hong Kong Warrant fund was the best performing fund year on year in August, reporting an annualized return of 67.33 percent.
Japanese warrants funds fell to 36th place out of a total of 41 sectors after coming first in the league for six consecutive months, the association said.
